triples.head_surface: explosions arising from improper functioning of starting valves
triples.head_canonical_zh: 启动阀故障引起的爆炸
triples.tail_surface: an isolation non-return valve or equivalent is to be installed at the starting air supply connection of each engine
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在每台发动机启动空气供应连接处安装隔离止回阀或等效装置
triples.evidence_text: in order to protect starting air mains against explosions arising from improper functioning of starting valves, an isolation non-return valve or equivalent is to be installed at the starting air supply connection of each engine
low starting air pressure is to be alarmed at that station

triples.tail_surface: provided with alarms for for low starting air pressures in the centralized control station
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在集中控制站设置启动空气低压报警
triples.evidence_text: Propulsion machinery spaces intended for centralized or unattended operations (ACC, ACCU or ABCU notation) are also to be provided with alarms for for low starting air pressures in the centralized control station
Hydrostatic tests are to be in accordance with 4-6-2/7.3.1 and 4-6-2/7.3.3

triples.tail_surface: tried under working condition in the presence of a Surveyor
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在验船师在场情况下进行工作条件试验
triples.evidence_text: The system is to be tried under working condition in the presence of a Surveyor

triples.tail_surface: insulation material is not to be of the oil-absorbing type unless encased in metal sheets or equivalent
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 绝缘材料不得为吸油型，除非用金属板或等效物包裹
triples.evidence_text: In places where oil spray or leakage can occur, the insulation material is not to be of the oil-absorbing type unless encased in metal sheets or equivalent

triples.head_surface: return of gases to an idle engine
triples.head_canonical_zh: 废气回流至停机发动机
triples.tail_surface: arranged to prevent the return of gases to an idle engine
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置成防止废气回流至停机发动机
triples.evidence_text: Exhaust pipes of several engines are not to be connected together, but are to be run separately to the atmosphere unless arranged to prevent the return of gases to an idle engine

triples.tail_surface: fitted with means to take account of the expansion and contraction
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装设考虑热胀冷缩的装置
triples.evidence_text: Exhaust pipes are to be adequately supported and fitted with means to take account of the expansion and contraction to prevent excessive strain on the pipes

triples.head_surface: any oil that may escape under pressure will not come in contact with exhaust gas piping
triples.head_canonical_zh: 防止带压逸出的油接触排气管
triples.tail_surface: Precautions are to be taken in the installation of equipment and piping handling fuel oil, lubricating oil and hydraulic oil
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在安装燃油、润滑油和液压油设备及管路时采取预防措施
triples.evidence_text: Precautions are to be taken in the installation of equipment and piping handling fuel oil, lubricating oil and hydraulic oil, such that any oil that may escape under pressure will not come in contact with exhaust gas piping
